name: features-bento
description: Mixed-size feature grid — bento layout. Each feature can be sized `default` (1 column) or `large` (2 columns) for visual rhythm. 4–8 features supported.

ai.whenToUse: Use mid-page for a richer, more visual feature showcase than a flat grid. Best when 1–2 features deserve more space (a flagship capability) and others are supporting. Common in SaaS launch pages and product reveals.
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't use if all features are equally important — `features-grid` is cleaner. Don't use with fewer than 4 features (looks lopsided).

headline.example: Everything you'd expect, nothing you wouldn't

subheadline.example: We sweat the details so you don't have to wire them up.

features.description: Feature tiles. Each declares an `icon`, `title`, `description`, and optional `span` ('default' or 'large').
